data.title: Adopt immutable repo-local .go workflow
data.context: Hermes Agent had no durable repo-local agent workflow contract. User requested the latest .go workflow, and the official latest release is go-workflow-stack v0.3.7 resolving to commit 307672f443d1b9297315fd17cce9704fc06b7fd2.
data.decision: .go is the sole workflow source of truth. The repository pins v0.3.7, uses ./go for immutable stack resolution, and forbids parallel .go-workflow or vault queues.
consequences: Agents must create and claim scoped JSON tasks before product edits, verify requested outcomes, append evidence, and finish through the pinned runtime.
